This DANGER Perfect Binder Cover Nipping Station sign from CGAP Safety reads: COVER NIPPING STATION / NIPPING PLATES CLOSE / ON EVERY BOOK / CRUSH HANDS / LOCK OUT TO CLEAR COVERS. Written for book manufacturers, trade binderies, commercial printers and print finishing shops.

Why this sign matters

Nipping plates rise and squeeze the cover onto the spine of every book with high force and crush hands fixing a cover.

Where to post it

At the cover nipping station.

Who orders it

Bindery supervisor, book plant maintenance lead, print finishing manager.
